name: Harry Melling
biography: Harry Edward Melling (born March 17, 1989) is an English actor known for playing Dudley Dursley in five Harry Potter films and for his role as Harry Beltik in The Queen's Gambit. His grandfather was actor Patrick Troughton.
movies: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
